target_claim: Every chordal graph can be obtained via clique pasting from two chordal graphs whose vertex sets are both proper subsets of its vertex set.
source_quote: A consequence of the first characterization is that $G$ is chordal if and only if $G$ can obtained from two chordal graphs $G_1$ and $G_2$, with $V(G_1) \subsetneq V(G)$ and $V(G_2) \subsetneq V(G)$, via clique pasting.
